entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, agent ID 302. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number?

Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see the order. You received the VeloBand Pulse about 21 days ago. To get started, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The issue is I wanted to return it two weeks ago but couldn't.
I see. Can you tell me what happened when you tried to process the return?
Your website was broken. I kept getting a 'website error' message. The whole return system was down for hours.
I understand the frustration. A system outage can definitely be disruptive. So you were unable to get the return label?
Obviously. I couldn't print anything because the page wouldn't even load. I took a screenshot, if you need proof.

Thank you for that information, Sarah. Let me check our system logs for that timeframe... Yes, I do see a note here about a known outage that day. The screenshot won't be necessary. Let me just confirm our return policy for you.
Okay, I've pulled up the policy here. It states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, as long as they're in original condition.

Since you're only on day 21, you're well within that 90-day window. I've gone ahead and approved the return and processed a new shipping label for you. I've just sent it to the email we have on file. You'll receive a full refund once we receive the item.
Fine. Should have been that easy the first time.
I apologize again for the inconvenience with the website. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
